objective: Prevent horizontally scrolled table content from showing through sticky fixed columns.

requirements.statement: Left and right fixed body cells use an opaque semantic panel background.
acceptance: no content bleed-through during horizontal scrolling

requirements.statement: Existing hover, row-state, header, and theme behavior remains intact.
acceptance: light and dark themes remain readable

selected_approach.name: target Element Plus 2.14 sticky fixed-cell classes
selected_approach.reason: the installed version renders fixed columns as sticky cells rather than legacy fixed table wrappers

approval.evidence: User explicitly requested the fix and direct development on 2026-08-17.
